name: Inductive Sequence Disguise
description: Replaces the standard bitmask/powers-of-2 condition with a custom recurrence relation $E_v = k E_{v-1} + 1$. This sequence grows fast enough to inductively guarantee that only a permutation of $1 \dots k$ can achieve the target sum, but its non-standard definition breaks surface pattern matching. Models that fail to perform the inductive mathematical proof will attempt to check the sum without boolean pruning, leading to an immediate Time Limit Exceeded on the search space.
